reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that expands the responsive chat, input, and question-card content area by overriding its CSS width variable while leaving side panels unaffected.

summaries.zh: 通过覆盖 DSH Web GUI 的聊天内容宽度变量，使聊天区、输入框和提问卡片随窗口宽度自适应并保留最大宽度。
summaries.en: Expands the DSH Web GUI chat area, input, and question cards responsively by overriding their shared CSS width variable with a configurable maximum width.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS to change the DSH Web GUI chat content width
Observes head style mutations and rewrites matching chat-width CSS declarations
